library.name: ZXing-js (@zxing/library)
library.description: TypeScript port of the ZXing barcode library: decodes QR codes and common 1D barcodes from a camera in the browser. The plugin's scanner uses ZXing on every browser (the native BarcodeDetector API is missing on Safari/Firefox and non-functional on desktop Chrome for Windows/Linux). See amd/src/readme_moodle.txt for the local changes.
